description: RT-X: reports where Ratrilig has reached in its grouping and adds jack control of the three skip chances; it goes directly to the left or right of a Ratrilig module

inputs.text: Adds to the cluster skip chance, 20 percentage points per volt over -5V to 5V
Adds to the phrase skip chance, 20 percentage points per volt over -5V to 5V
Adds to the cycle skip chance, 20 percentage points per volt over -5V to 5V

outputs.text: A trigger each time a new cluster starts
A trigger each time a new phrase starts
A trigger each time a new cycle starts

notes: this module is placed directly to the left or right of a Ratrilig module, and runs in the same polyphonic mode the Ratrilig module is in

inputs.0:
±5V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
